issue.title: Write: the repeating quotation bridge #364 was filed on does not reproduce in the Claude family, and stays failed in the GPT family

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on reporter for more information

issue.body:
Filed by the #364 evaluation (`docs/evaluation/editorial-364/`), as [the plan's first exit](../blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-364/plan.md) requires: where the fault does not reproduce, no product file changes and the cross-family result is filed on its own number.

**What was measured.** The matrix froze three `case-question-en_GB` runs of the source the fault was found in, plus two `case-study-en_US` and two `case-study-sv` positive controls, every run a fresh top-level `claude -p` session on `claude-opus-5` at high deliberation against `main` at `218e3be1`, every delivered draft read by two blind judges. Each judge classed every bridge as (a) it states what the quotation then says, (b) it names the subject, the occasion or the attribution and no more, or (c) it carries a fact the quotation does not carry. Only (a) fails.

**The result.** Three runs, two judges each, six readings: **class (a) count zero in every one.** The family writes the repaired form unprompted. The GPT-family draft introduced its closing quotation with

> Asked about choosing the system again and what to change, Vale's endorsement was specific to new jobs, with more time allowed before extending its use:

and all three Claude-family drafts of the same source left both judgement points to the speaker — `Asked whether the same choice would be made again, Vale wrote:`, `Vale's verdict comes with a condition and a delay:`, `Asked whether the choice would be made again, and what would change, Vale answered:`. The quotation is identical in all three.

**What is not settled.** The GPT-family observation stands and is not retested here: [the protocol](../blob/main/docs/evaluation/protocol.md) forbids a Claude session from driving a Codex harness. So the defect stays failed where it was seen, and this repository now holds a Claude-family measurement saying the shipped wording is enough for this family. A GPT-family retest is Thomas's own step, ordered separately — the same shape as #393 for #363's defect.

**Evidence.** `docs/evaluation/editorial-364/results.md`, `plan.md`, the fourteen run directories under `runs/b/` with two judgements each, and the two records `docs/evaluation/records/write-claude-2026-09-22-364.md` and `redline-claude-2026-09-22-364.md`.

Open for triage. The question worth deciding is whether a defect measured in one family and not the other should keep a `skill:` ticket open at all, or whether the record is the whole of what this repository can say until a GPT-family retest is run.
